title: L-shaped stairs with a landing or winders
purpose: Generate quarter-turn stairs: two straight flights joined by a square landing or by three winder treads cut at 30 degree steps from the inner corner, turning left or right, with an optional support block. Use it where a stair must turn a corner.

parameters.name: first_steps
parameters.description: Treads in the first flight, along +Y.

parameters.name: second_steps
parameters.description: Treads in the second flight, after the turn.

parameters.name: corner
parameters.description: Fill the corner with one landing or three winder treads.

parameters.name: turn
parameters.description: Direction of the second flight seen from the first.

parameters.name: rise
parameters.description: Height of one step, also between the landing and its neighbours.

parameters.name: going
parameters.description: Horizontal depth of one straight tread.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of both flights; the corner square has this side.

parameters.name: tread_thickness
parameters.description: Thickness of every tread and of the landing.

parameters.name: support
parameters.description: Add a block under the corner from the floor to the corner treads.

outputs.description: One mesh object named L-Shaped Stairs made of closed treads.

limits: Winders radiate from the inner corner, so their inner ends are very narrow; real stairs often offset the pivot to keep a minimum inner tread, which this generator does not do. No stringers, risers or handrail. Parts are separate closed solids in one mesh. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
